**Verdict: not built - needs a maintainer look.** The read found no blockers. This review did not build or run the code: no local build slot was open this tick, and the PR is from an outside account, so the test runner refuses it.

**What looks good**

- The new `bore_helix.rs` obeys the Prime Directive: `stepdown <= 0` and non-finite values are refused by the shared doors in `bore.rs:139`, the turn count is guarded before the `as usize` cast, and both refusals name the hole, its position, the core left, and the fix to type.
- The `Rings` path is untouched: the default keeps its digest bytes, its stamp, and its posted JSON. `finished()` now applies the approach refusal to both strategies.
- Layering and placement are right: the strategy enum lives in `machining2d`, `app` and `ui` only re-use it; the new test files sit in the crate that provides what they import, each with a Gate map line; the decision file is there.
- The law checks pass: one commit, conventional subject, `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #2830` at the end; no CHANGELOG, golden, snapshot PNG, `PROCESS_VERSION`, `.github`, scripts, or dependency change. The posted G-code comes from our own `assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps`; no vendor material.
- The project round-trip is additive and correct: `helical`/`spring_pass` are written only when true, an older file reads as `Rings`, and `bore_helical.rs` pins it.

**Results**

- Not built, not run: this review is read-only. GitHub reports the head mergeable with `main`.
- Your reported gates are noted but not verified here: quick gate green on the final head, clippy clean, and the heavy run on c70e84309.

**Heavy lanes**

- You list `cargo xtask gate heavy` on the final head c70e84309: the motion and app heavy lanes, 231 steps, 0 failed. The head matches this review, so the record stands as yours; this review did not repeat it.

**Requested before merge**

- None from this review.

**Questions and notes (not blocking)**

1. On the Passes tab, Rings -> Helical -> Rings -> Helical resets `spring_pass` to false. A stored value would keep it. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:335` (`bore_strategy_rows`).
2. You note the page does not reseed `stepdown` when the strategy changes, so the carried 5 mm default gives the 17.7 deg refusal on a common hole. The message names the pitch to type, so it recovers; an auto-fit note in the issue follow-up may be worth a `P7`.
3. `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs:213-226`: `fields.sort_by` now runs twice for `bore` (the `break_through` block sorts, then the new block sorts). One block after both pushes would do. Cosmetic.
4. @sn3ro was the air-cut offer on the issue taken up? The body says no machine test yet; the counterbore posted cleanly in your scratch test, which is a good sign.

**Merging note**: this is a `feat`, so it waits for the next minor cut. It is not put in the merge-ready queue now; the yellow label records that a maintainer must build it (or grant a build slot) before it is counted as tested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Verdict: Not built — disk guard; needs the pr-test runner or a maintainer look.** No blockers found in the read.

This is a SAFET-tier PR (it changes toolpath generation and posted G-code for the Bore operation). The maintainer capped local review builds today (disk guard, 2026-11-22T13:05Z), so this review read the code and did not compile it. This is a fork PR, so the author cannot start `pr-test.yml`; a maintainer run of the quick gate and clippy on the merged tree is what this verdict waits for. The label moves from `needs-rework` to `needs-maintainer`: the two items of the review at `c70e84309` are addressed (below), and this read found no new blocker.

## Read of the delta since the last review

Both requested items are fixed:

1. The `equal_steps.rs` compile error: head commit `4bd091166` adds `strategy: Default::default()` to main's new Bore literal. I scanned the merged tree (all `OpParams::Bore` and `machining2d::BoreParams` construction sites): every full literal now names `strategy`, and main added no new Bore literal since the merge-base.
2. Before/after screenshots are in the body (Passes tab, Heights tab; Rings and Helical).

## The core question: overlap with #3386 and #3113 on main

Main moved twice past this branch's merge (`2d98d87be`): `#3386` (separate inside and outside boundary offsets, merged at `d576881ad`) and `#3113` (Circular ring links, merged at `68d645261`). Current main is `b44a422bb`.

- No duplication or contradiction. #3386 changes the boundary/area path (`crates/app/src/operation/boundary*.rs`, `types/area.rs`, the boundary UI rows). This PR changes the Bore hole path (`machining2d/bore*.rs`, the Bore arm of `OpParams`, the bore DTO). Neither side edits the other's files. The `rc = R - r - leave` wall circle here is the ring ladder's own law, not the boundary offset.
- #3113 changes `machining2d/circular.rs` (the Circular operation's ring links). The Bore ring ladder is separate code (`bore.rs`), untouched by #3113.
- Textual trial merge with current main: `git merge-tree` reports clean, no conflicted file. Nine files changed on both sides (`generate.rs`, `kinds.rs`, `types/params.rs`, `project/params*.rs`, `mcp/job.rs`, `machining2d/mod.rs`, `ui tests.rs`, the guide); the PR's additions there are all inside the Bore arm, and main's additions in those files touch no Bore line (verified by diffing the added lines).
- One compile risk I could check without a build: main adds no new full `BoreParams`/`OpParams::Bore` literal since the merge-base, and the merged tree has no full literal without `strategy`. A merged build should compile; it is not proven here.

## What looks good

- The two refusals sit in `BoreParams::validate` before any move is built (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore.rs:210`), and the common doors ahead of them protect the helix math: `stepdown > 0` (`bore.rs:139`), `rc > 0` (`bore.rs:195`), `floor_z < top_z` (`bore.rs:173`), `hop >= top` (`bore.rs:162`). With those, `sweep` cannot divide by zero and `drop` cannot be negative; the `n.is_finite()`/`n <= 1e6` guard (`bore_helix.rs:148`) closes the rest. The core door proves `rc <= floor reach`, so the feed to the centre cannot drag material.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in the new non-test code; the only `expect`s are in a `#[cfg(test)]` block (`crates/app/src/project/params_impl.rs`).
- Project round-trip obeys the law: `helical` and `spring_pass` are additive (`skip_serializing_if = "is_false"`, `default`), an older file reads Rings, no version step; the digest writes the strategy word only for a helical Bore (`crates/app/src/operation/params/holes.rs:120`), so ring ladders keep their stamps.
- Layering is clean: `bore_helix.rs` lives in motion and uses only `crate::cl`/`crate::geometry`; app reads it through `OpParams::Bore::strategy`; the UI writes the field through the page's existing params-command path (same pattern as every other row in `holes_page.rs`). No new crate dependency; no Cargo.toml, build.rs, .github, scripts or `.cargo` change.
- Provenance comment present (`bore_helix.rs:1-13`); files are within the size rule (173 and 354 lines). No golden or snapshot PNG change. Guide and refusal rows updated; `docs/decisions/2830-helical-bore.md` present. Body has the `Changelog:` line, ends `Fixes #2830`, commit subjects are conventional, and `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched.
- The earlier mutation testing (mkinney, at `c70e84309`): all three safety mutations went red, so the tests pin the doors. Those commits are unchanged here.

## Results

- Not built in this review (disk guard; no local build allowed). The prior collaborator review built `c70e84309` merged with the main of that day: quick gate green except the one `equal_steps` literal, and clippy clean once that one field was added.
- Author's report on this head `4bd091166` (base `2d98d87be`, older than current main): quick gate 724 steps 0 failed; clippy clean on all eight crates; heavy 240 steps (202 app, 37 motion) 0 failed with the 6 expected known-fails (#1950, #2849). Head matches; base is behind #3386/#3113, so the runner or maintainer owes one re-run on the merged tree.

## Heavy lanes

The diff reaches the motion and app heavy lanes. The PR body names a green author run of them on this head; the base was `2d98d87be`. This review could not rerun them (disk guard). Treat the author's heavy result as current only after the runner or a maintainer re-runs `cargo xtask gate heavy` against `b44a422bb`.

## Requested before merge

None from this review. The one gate on the merge is the build itself: run the quick gate and clippy on the merged tree (pr-test runner with a maintainer dispatch, or a local build when disk allows), then the heavy lanes if quick is green.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The body notes the page does not change the stepdown when the strategy flips, so a 5 mm default pitch is refused on a Ø11 hole until the user types 4.2 mm. A future polish could seed a default pitch. Not this PR's job.
- `crates/app/src/project/params_impl.rs` is far over the 400-line file rule (pre-existing); this PR adds 10 lines. A split is owed outside this PR.
- The strategy combo writes through the op-page params-command path like its sibling rows; the new `bore_strategy` UI test asserts the rows and values, not positions.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
